title: Impact of the hole transport layer on the space charge distribution and hysteresis in perovskite solar cells analysed by capacitance–voltage profiling
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1225-1235
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01262C, Paper
E. Regalado-Pérez, Evelyn B. Díaz-Cruz, J. Villanueva-Cab
The interplay of interface-accumulated mobile ions and electronic carriers governs the apparent doping profiles (Nappvs. W). The hole transport layer influences the shape of the apparent doping profiles by modulating interfacial charge accumulation.
